title: Running Median

links.title: LeetCode: Find Median from Data Stream

hints: Keeping a sorted vector and inserting each number costs O(n) per add. Can you do better by only caring about the MIDDLE?
Split the numbers into a lower half and an upper half. You only need the largest of the lower half and the smallest of the upper half.
Use a max-heap for the lower half (std::priority_queue<int>) and a min-heap for the upper half (std::priority_queue<int, std::vector<int>, std::greater<>>).
After every add, rebalance so the heap sizes differ by at most 1 (and let the lower half be the bigger one when the count is odd).
